Network.Technology: GSM/GPRS/EDGE Quad-band (850/900/1800/1900) , UMTS/HSPA tri-band (900/1700/2100) , HSDPA 7.2 Mbit/s , GPRS Class 10 (4+1/3+2 slots), 32-48 kbit/s

Platform.CPU: GSM 600 MHz Qualcomm MSM7227 ARM1136EJ-S , CDMA 600 MHz MSM7627 ARM1136EJ-S

Memory.Storage: 512 MB ROM (140 or 170 MB user addressable)

Display.Display: TFT LCD, 2.8 in diagonal , 240×320 pixels QVGA @ 206 ppi, 3:4 aspect-ratio standard screen , 256K colors

Cameras.Rear camera: VGA video recording (640×480 px, MPEG4 at 18 fps max.), Auto-focus , Europe and Asia 3-megapixels , United States and Canada 3.15 megapixels (2048×1536 px max.)

Connectivity.Connectivity: 3.5 mm TRRS , Bluetooth 2.1 + EDR with A2DP , FM stereo receiver (87.5-108 MHz) with RDS (certain variants) , Micro USB 2.0 , Wi-Fi 802.11b/g
